supported_recipe_scope: body proportion controls in character recipe body
profile archetype, feature toggles, palette, and intended-action metadata
limitations: The Blender builder creates low-detail parametric blockout geometry, not a finished or perfect mesh.
Anatomy relationship prose and material tags are retained as recipe evidence but are not geometry instructions yet.
The model-recipe-v1 cross-category contract is not consumed by this character-stage plan.
A human must review proportions, silhouette, hands, wrists, topology, and the complete T-pose.

concept.source_prompt: A believable, high-end realistic fantasy stone troll for a premium modern game: moss-green skin with subtle slate mottling, amber eyes, a broad heavy nose, short swept-back horns, small ivory lower tusks, and broad pointed ears. Massive and strong with natural humanlike anatomy, grounded proportions, detailed hands, and a calm, approachable expression. It walks, runs, jumps, climbs, and idles.
concept.design_summary: Realistic fantasy troll with an anatomically grounded heavy build, broad heavy nose and jaw, moss-green skin, slate mottling, amber eyes, swept-back horns, small ivory tusks, and broad pointed ears.
assumptions: The procedural base remains a blockout and does not provide finished troll-specific topology or surface detail.
The CC-BY Troll Mauler is an authoring reference only; its rest pose and design differ from this concept. It is not used as generated geometry.
The requested actions are rig requirements; this profile does not generate animation clips.

relations: scapula supports the deltoid and upper arm
pectorals blend chest into the front of the upper arm
latissimus blends back into the rear of the upper arm
axilla is a continuous concave transition between torso and upper arm
anatomy_relationships.surface_policy: Generate as one continuous deformable body surface with a smooth shoulder-to-chest transition; no floating shoulder or armpit filler objects.

relations: upper arm joins the shoulder girdle
forearm joins upper arm at elbow
anatomy_relationships.surface_policy: Maintain surface continuity through the neutral pose and preserve volume across joint landmarks.
